# Generated by Aegis CI Integration
# Project: Test Project
# Repository: cmuktxolo0004iii0u535w0mw
# Do not edit directly - regenerate via API

name: "Aegis Quality Check - Test Project"

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Run Aegis Analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Start Analysis Run
        id: analysis
        run: |
          echo "run_id=$(curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/api/analyses" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.AEGIS_API_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"projectId":"cmuktxolo0004iii0u535w0mw","repositoryId":"cmuktxolo0004iii0u535w0mw","adapters":["typescript","eslint"]}' \
            | jq -r '.data.id')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Wait for Analysis
        run: |
          for i in {1..30}; do
            status=$(curl -s "http://localhost:3000/api/api/analyses/${{ steps.analysis.outputs.run_id }}" \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.AEGIS_API_TOKEN }}" | jq -r '.data.status')
            echo "Status: $status"
            if [[ "$status" == "COMPLETED" ]]; then exit 0; fi
            if [[ "$status" == "FAILED" ]]; then exit 1; fi
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Timeout waiting for analysis"
          exit 1

      - name: Check Merge Gate
        if: ${{ true }}
        run: |
          gate=$(curl -s "http://localhost:3000/api/api/analyses/${{ steps.analysis.outputs.run_id }}/gate" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.AEGIS_API_TOKEN }}" | jq -r '.data.allowed')
          if [[ "$gate" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Merge gate failed - quality checks did not pass"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Merge gate passed"
